attchmntText: Intimation regarding cessation of Novelis (China) Aluminum Products Co. Ltd. and Novelis (Shanghai) Aluminum Trading Co. Ltd, wholly-owned subsidiaries of Novelis Inc. a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries Limited ["Company"], as subsidiaries of the Company.
voiceSummary: Hindalco Industries Limited has entered into a definitive agreement on November 14, 2026, to sell its wholly-owned subsidiaries Novelis China Aluminum Products Co. Ltd. and Novelis Shanghai Aluminum Trading Co. Ltd. to Shenzhen Hongzhi Industrial Investment Co. Ltd. The transaction consideration is approximately USD 265 million, with a potential contingent earn-out of USD 10 million. Closing is expected within 12 months, subject to regulatory approvals. The entities contributed USD 376 million in net sales and USD 259 million in net worth during the last financial year, representing approximately 1% and 2% of the Company’s respective totals. The buyers are not part of the promoter group. The transaction is not a related party deal and does not fall under a scheme of arrangement.

attchmntText: Sarthak Metals Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Sarthak Metals Limited filed its Q2 FY2026-2027 earnings presentation with the BSE and NSE on 15th November 2026. Revenue from operations rose 44% year-on-year to Rs 52.37 crore. EBITDA margin improved 146 basis points sequentially to 4.27%. Profit after tax was Rs 1.28 crore, compared to Rs 0.76 crore in Q2 FY2025-2026. Earnings per share stood at Rs 0.92. Cored wire volumes increased 37% year-on-year to 1,463 tonnes. Welding division revenue grew 49% year-on-year to Rs 5.6 crore. Aluminium flipping coil volumes decreased 13% year-on-year to 156 tonnes. Short-term borrowings reduced to Rs 2.6 crore from Rs 6.6 crore in March 2026. Operating cash flow generated was Rs 4.1 crore. The company aims for Rs 25 crore annual sales in the welding segment for FY27.

attchmntText: Swaraj Suiting Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Strong Growth Continues".
voiceSummary: Swaraj Suiting Limited filed press release regarding consolidated and standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results. Standalone revenue from operations grew 72.3% year on year to INR 2,195.2 Mn in Q2 FY27 and 97.3% to INR 4,028.9 Mn in H1 FY27. Net profit increased 94.5% to INR 172.9 Mn in Q2 FY27 and 96.9% to INR 335.1 Mn in H1 FY27. Earnings per share stood at INR 6.55 in Q2 FY27 and INR 12.69 in H1 FY27. Finished fabric manufacturing capacity is expected to increase by approximately 30 Mn Mtrs by Q4 FY28. The company aims to meet up to 50% of electricity requirements through renewable energy by the end of FY28.

attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revised Outcome of Board Meeting dated 14th November, 2026 '.
voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026, to correct a typographical error in the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company stated the correction is clerical and does not impact financial figures or profitability. Independent auditors Lodha & Co issued an adverse review report on the financial results. The auditors cited significant uncertainties regarding the recoverability of Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs, with Rs. 41,421 lakhs remaining unprovided. Other issues included non-determination of fair values for assets, lease rents, and statutory liabilities, as well as non-recognition of interest on loans. The report highlighted a going concern assumption due to current liabilities exceeding current assets and operational losses affecting net worth. Borrowings have been restructured subject to conditions precedent, and the company's ability to continue depends on fulfilling these conditions and asset monetization.
